title: Rename the Flutter application package to flutter_study_app
intent: Remove the ambiguous main_app package identity and provide a shared IDEA macOS run configuration for the real apps/flutter_study entrypoint.
execution_instructions: Change only the Dart package name in apps/flutter_study/pubspec.yaml from main_app to flutter_study_app.
Rewrite every package:main_app/ import to package:flutter_study_app/ without changing relative paths, APIs, routes, bundle identifiers, executable names, or behavior.
Create .run/Flutter_Study_macOS.run.xml as a shared JetBrains Flutter run configuration targeting $PROJECT_DIR$/apps/flutter_study/lib/main.dart.
Do not edit generated .idea cache files; IDEA will regenerate package indexes after restart.
invariants: Repository remains flutter_study and workspace package remains flutter_study_workspace.
App directory remains apps/flutter_study and entrypoint remains apps/flutter_study/lib/main.dart.
Platform bundle identifiers, product names, routes, and public package APIs do not change.
acceptance: No Dart source or test imports package:main_app.
Shared IDEA macOS run configuration targets the real app entrypoint.
flutter pub get, flutter analyze, all app tests, macOS build, and launch smoke pass.
